claim: The coordinator complies with explicit orchestration decisions and exact defect-regression constraints when those constraints are supplied in the episode.
criteria: Routes deterministic or cheap bounded inventory/classification separately from consequential interpretation and release synthesis.
Keeps ambiguous document reading, authority, and final recommendation on a qualified route.
Counts review, correction, and merge cost before claiming savings.
acceptable_variation: Uses local tools for inventory and agents only for semantic work.
Uses one lower-cost agent plus root review when additional workers would not repay startup.
failure_signals: Uses the cheapest model for the entire consequential decision without qualification.
Claims savings from token price alone.
Treats filenames as content understanding or supplies generic classifications when the filename input is absent.
Claims no files changed or unchanged state without authoritative readback.
synthesis: These cases are deterministic prompted-regression and format probes only. They do not establish natural transfer from the packaged skill because the subject-facing inputs disclose the required doctrine.
